rows.label: Study notes
rows.text: **Geometry of a prism.** The refracting angle of the prism equals the sum of the internal angles, A = r₁ + r₂, whatever the incidence.  ·  **Angle of deviation.** The ray turns through δ = (i₁ + i₂) − A, where i₁ and i₂ are the angles at the two faces.  ·  **Minimum deviation.** Deviation is least when the ray passes symmetrically (i₁ = i₂, r₁ = r₂ = A/2); then δ_m = 2i − A — the setting used in all prism measurements.
